negative_reviews.author: Massimiliano Vitali
negative_reviews.text:
Looking at all the positive reviews, I don't understand whether they are all fake or whether I was just unlucky.
We entered the restaurant without a reservation, and the manager didn't seem very happy to welcome us.
No one pointed out that there were specials on a board on the wall. We had to ask twice for our drinks because they never arrived, and three times for tap water. No one asked us about allergies when taking our order. The food was well presented but of fairly average quality. Nothing I ordered really stood out. There was no salmon available, and the only dessert was unavailable too. I didn't have a great experience.

issues: Maki Nori did £19.8K last week, a slight uptick, which Ginger put down to being booked out a bit more (Admin Meeting 02/11).
Covers rose by 106 week on week (Maki Nori GM/HC meeting 03/11).

Labour cost was reduced by the new closing hours, and the site will close on Mondays and Tuesdays from this week to cut staff costs (Maki Nori GM/HC meeting 03/11 and Maki Nori project meeting 29/10).
Successes were service and food quality, store management, communication and coordination, food presentation and Omakase (Maki Nori GM/HC meeting 03/11).
Areas to improve are service standards, compliance, upselling and cleaning, and reviews still need to improve (Maki Nori GM/HC meeting 03/11).
Hygiene checks were 100% compliant with many cleaning tasks now in Mapal for FOH and BOH, all waste was tracked, and a deep clean is arranged for the coming days (Maki Nori GM/HC meeting 03/11).
Pest control is monitoring, and nematode sightings have fallen after recent isolation work (Maki Nori GM/HC meeting 03/11 and Maki Nori project meeting 29/10).
Promotions: Omakase nights run Wednesday to Friday and the lunch promo is supported by table materials and window posters; the new Omakase material is not ready yet (Maki Nori GM/HC meeting 03/11).
Credit card holds are now taken on new bookings after unsecured last minute cancellations hit sales and wages (Maki Nori project meeting 29/10).
Influencer visits have stopped, which may have contributed to the downturn, while social media is posted every two days (Maki Nori project meeting 29/10).
A significant amount of fish was discarded after the dry age fridge was left open, and FOH staff must not operate the dry age fridge (Maki Nori project meeting 29/10).
For fully booked Omakase sessions (nine covers at £88 per head), a dedicated FOH team member will run the floor so the chef can focus on presentation (Maki Nori project meeting 29/10).

Maintenance: a misconnection between the plate table and the machine is causing a leak in the KP area, which Remy is addressing, and a new leak is leaving puddles near the rice room; Ross has been told (Maki Nori project meeting 29/10).
Michael Salvador said Maki Nori will close on 30/11 and hopefully reopen for three weeks for Christmas (Ops meeting 03/11; Gemini's summary wrongly says Norwich).
Ziang Lin reported sales of £19,800, up £5,000 on the week before but still below target, with covers up by about 100 and spend per head over £42 (London KPI meeting 03/11).
Labour fell by about 10 percentage points to 39% after staff cuts, and kitchen staff will rotate between Shoreditch and Soho to stabilise it (London KPI meeting 03/11 and AM Updates 04/11).
Reviews: five 5 star and one 2 star pulled the weekly rating to 4.5, and Ziang Lin called the low review volume an effort problem that needs daily habits (London KPI meeting 03/11).

The 2 star review cited slow service, out of stock items such as salmon that were not communicated, and a missed allergy check; Ziang Lin said allergy checks are mandatory for all FOH staff and replies must go by professional email, not Facebook (London KPI meeting 03/11).
Hot and sushi chefs have refused to do kitchen porter duties or cross train, and Teddy Lee warned of food waste risk from the two day weekly closure (AM Updates 04/11).
